by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ s A B C T hA hB hC hAB hs hang
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  have hmA := left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A B
  have hmB := right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A B
  have hTA : T ≠ A := fun h => hs.2.1 (h ▸ hmA)
  have hCA : C ≠ A := fun h => hs.2.2 (h ▸ hmA)
  have hCB : C ≠ B := fun h => hs.2.2 (h ▸ hmB)
  have hOA : s.center ≠ A := by
    intro h
    apply hAB
    have h1 : dist B s.center = s.radius := hB
    have h2 : dist A s.center = s.radius := hA
    rw [h, dist_self] at h2
    rw [h, ← h2, dist_eq_zero] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have hsign : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle T A B).sign = (EuclideanGeometry.oangle A C B).sign := by
    rw [hs.oangle_sign_eq_neg hmA hmB, EuclideanGeometry.oangle_swap₁₂_sign]
  have heq : EuclideanGeometry.oangle T A B = EuclideanGeometry.oangle A C B :=
    EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_of_angle_eq_of_sign_eq hang hsign
  have hadd := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_add hTA hOA hAB.symm
  have hpi := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.two_zsmul_oangle_center_add_two_zsmul_oangle_eq_pi hA hC hB hCA hCB hAB
  have h2T : (2 : ℤ) • EuclideanGeometry.oangle T A s.center = (Real.pi : Real.Angle) := by
    have h3 : (2 : ℤ) • EuclideanGeometry.oangle T A s.center = (2 : ℤ) • EuclideanGeometry.oangle T A B - (2 : ℤ) • EuclideanGeometry.oangle s.center A B := by
      rw [← hadd, smul_add]; abel
    rw [h3, heq, ← hpi, EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rev B A s.center, smul_neg]
    abel
  have h90 : EuclideanGeometry.angle T A s.center = Real.pi / 2 := by
    rcases Real.Angle.two_zsmul_eq_pi_iff.mp h2T with h | h
    · exact EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_pi_div_two_of_oangle_eq_pi_div_two h
    · exact EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_pi_div_two_of_oangle_eq_neg_pi_div_two h
  exact EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.IsTangentAt_of_angle_eq_pi_div_two h90 hA
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B C T : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → C ∈ s → A ≠ B → (line[ℝ, A, B]).SOppSide T C → EuclideanGeometry.angle T A B = EuclideanGeometry.angle A C B → s.IsTangentAt A line[ℝ, A, T]
